name: points
purpose: A cloud of glowing dots, with a label for each if you want: the real bright stars (stars), your own places (pts), a state list (of), or N places round a circle (round), such as a zodiac.
binds: pts: numbers or state keys; of: a state list of [x, y, z]

stars.doc: true: 815 real stars on a far shell round the scene; right ascension and declination give the place, the colour index gives the colour

frame.doc: with stars: ecliptic puts the plane of the Sun's path flat (the x and z axes); equatorial puts the celestial equator flat

radius.doc: with stars: the radius of the shell, in sizes of the scene

pts.doc: the places [x, y, z]; an item can be a state key

of.doc: the state key of a list of points, each [x, y, z] or {x, y, z}

round.doc: N places round a circle, one in the middle of each slice; with edge the dots sit on the edges between slices

r.doc: with round: the radius of the circle

about.doc: with round: the centre, [0, 0, 0] if left out

axis.doc: with round: the axis across the circle, [0, 1, 0] if left out (a flat circle)

offset.doc: with round: the angle in degrees of the start of the first slice; 0 is along x

edge.doc: with round: the dots sit on the edges between slices, and the names stay in the middles

names.doc: a short label for each place, in order; at most 24 characters each

size.doc: the size of a dot, in pixels

tone.doc: the colour of the dots of pts and of

opacity.doc: how bright the dots are; 1 if left out

show.doc: a state key; the dots show when its value is true

step.doc: the dots show from this step of the scene
